description: Micro-verdict for gate lanes: the status field is the entire verdict.

status.description: pass: every check the prompt names ran and succeeded. fail: at least one named check failed. blocked: a named check could not run at all.

summary.description: At most two sentences, carrying the one evidence cite (file:line, or command plus output line) that proves the status. For fail, lead with the first failing check; for blocked, name the obstacle without guessing the outcome; for pass, name what ran.
